title.narrative: Technical Support to Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA)

description.narrative: This activity Technical Support to Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA) is a component of Health Consortium for the Somali People (HCS) Programme 2009-2016 reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £619,102. It works in the following sector(s): Reproductive health care, Family planning.
